reason: First frozen sample exposed weak candidate recall; title priority alone produced no improvement. Fresh sample excludes its annotated pages and near claims; first held-out is already inspected and is not reused as untouched evidence.

retrieval.query: One bounded query: legacy OR intitle quoted exact leading English subject, before a copular/modal predicate, stripped initial article and trailing in/on/at location phrase; <=8 tokens and <=120 characters; <=500 query chars total. No annotations supplied to query builder.
retrieval.ranking: Unchanged BM25; exact subject-title priority measured separately, no adoption without improvement.
retrieval.adoption: Validation known-page Recall@6 increases, MRR and nDCG@3 do not decrease; no threshold tuning after results. Held-out tested once without retuning.
retrieval.metrics: Known annotated evidence-page Recall@1/3/6, full-list MRR and binary known-page nDCG@1/3/6. Unlisted pages remain unjudged, no passage relevance accuracy claim.
retrieval.runtime: Sequential strategy calls may have order/time bias; latency descriptive, not controlled optimization. No factual assessment changes.
